what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Burkina Faso by conflict and violence, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR and shown side by side.
At the end of 2025 both sources give the same figure, 2062534 people.
Refugees from Burkina Faso numbered 351209 at the end of 2025 and live mainly in Mali and Côte d'Ivoire.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burkina Faso with JNIM from 2018 to 2025, at war level from 2022.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2019 to 2025.
Floods are the disasters recorded for Burkina Faso in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 700 in 2016 to 2062534 in 2023 and stayed at that level in 2024 and 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025, in the same years as the conflicts UCDP records.
IDMC recorded the most new displacements from conflict in 2023.

how.text: UNHCR's and IDMC's figures overlap and are counted differently, so they are shown side by side and never added.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
The sources don't say where inside Burkina Faso people moved to.
